scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide city street with a man riding a bicycle along the bike lane, surrounded by buildings and trees. The street is paved with asphalt and has white markings indicating the bike lane, including a large white square with a bicycle symbol and a smaller square with a person riding a bicycle. The street is lined with tall trees and buildings, some of which have balconies and windows. A few cars are parked along the curb, and there are several pedestrians walking along the sidewalk. The sky is overcast.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings are multi-story structures made of stone and brick, with ornate facades and decorative details such as columns and arches. Some of the buildings have balconies with iron railings, while others have large windows and doors. There are also several shops and restaurants along the street, including a cafe with outdoor seating.
